ambient_trade.text: two good saddles in {town} for {gold}. i'll come down a little if you're quick about it
anyone need horses near {town}? fresh stock, {gold} a head, and i know the road
buying tack in {town}, paying well above the usual {gold}. bring me the bridles :)
tack prices in {town} dipped again. i've seen worse, still a decent time to buy
spare horse in {town}? will sell for {gold} and throw in a bridle for the trouble

encounter_trade_offer.text: {player}, i won't sell you a thing at {gold} after that stunt. name a real figure and we can talk
{player}, i'll give you a saddle for {gold} in {town}. take it or leave it, the road is long
{player} my friend, {gold} for the pair and i'll ride with you to {town} myself. deal?
{player}, {gold} is light for those horses. meet me in {town} and we'll see what sticks
{player}, you have a sharp offer there. {gold} plus a bridle and it's done, and i'll owe you one

encounter_greeting.text: {player}! {persona} of {my_faction}. been a while. got any tack to move or do you want to buy?
{player}, {persona} of {my_faction}. no need for swords, i only want to talk prices
{player}, {persona} of {my_faction}. we both know you've robbed that road. still, a quick word about prices?
{persona} here, {my_faction} colors on my wagon, {player}. i'm buying saddles, not fighting.
{player}, good to see you on the road. {persona} of {my_faction} at your service, for a fair cut

player_raided_my_village.text: burning {village}? {player}, that is bad for trade on every road around here. no one buys from ashes
{player}, you burned {village}. i lost a wagon's worth of trade there. bad business and i won't forget it
{village} is burnt out. whoever did it has scared off every buyer from here to the coast
{player}, i heard about {village}. no hard feelings yet, but raids drive off the buyers i need

war_declared.text: {my_faction} and {enemy_faction} at war again. every road is closed and nobody is buying saddles
war with {enemy_faction}? fine, but someone pay for the caravans we're going to lose
{my_faction} declared on {enemy_faction}. i'm counting the cost in tolls and spoiled stock. hate this
so {enemy_faction} is the enemy now. the tolls on that road just went up, mark my words

peace_made.text: {my_faction} and {faction} at peace. finally the caravans can move. stock up on tack while prices settle
peace with {faction} means cheaper roads and fewer bandits. good for business, mostly
{faction} signed peace with {my_faction}. wagons are rolling again and the saddles are moving
{my_faction} is at peace with {faction}. the inns will be full and the horses will sell :)

released_by_player.text: {player}, thank you for letting me go instead of ransoming me. i'll remember it in my ledger, discount's yours
{player} let me go without ransom. fair dealing, i'll say that for them
{player}, you released me without a ransom. i still count my stolen stock as owed, mind you
{player} released me with no ransom. first honest deal i've had all month, saddle's on me next time

beat_by_player.text: {player} beat {troop_count} of my men on the road. my saddles are gone again. this is what the bandits do
{player}, {troop_count} men lost in that fight. i'll pay for the wagons back, can we talk terms?
{player}, {troop_count} of my men are on foot now. well fought. i'll still sell you a saddle at cost
{player}, {troop_count} men gone. you fight well, but every wagon you burn costs me money
{player} beat {troop_count} men of mine. fair fight, and i'll make the cost back in tolls

whisper_beg_help.text: {player}, {enemy_faction} is at the gate of {fief}. send some men or come sell me your goods, i'll pay well
{player}, {enemy_faction} may take {fief}. no one buys goods from a burnt town. name your price for help
{player} i'm losing {fief} to {enemy_faction}. help me hold it and i'll owe you a season of cheap tack
{player}, {fief} is nearly lost to {enemy_faction}. i can offer coin for the ride, won't pretend otherwise

ambient_complaint.text: bandits again on the road out of {town}. three wagons gone this week and nobody pays for losses
{rival} undercut my saddles in {town} again. selling at a loss is not my hobby
{faction} tolls are robbery. paid twice on one wagon and still got a pinched receipt
{rival} says my price is high. look at the toll bill, then tell me who's robbing whom
{town} market is dead since the raids. nothing moves now but bandits and their friends

ambient_chatter.text: rain on the road to {town} again. every saddle i own smells like wet leather
{village} has the best cheese on this side of the river, don't tell the tollmen
anyone seen a good horse trader in {town}? i'm tired of my own company on this road
my wagon axle broke outside {village} :( six hours to fix it, nothing stolen at least
lag again on the eastern road. at least the caravans are slow enough to catch up
